method: UMA-s-1p1 Langevin MD, fit window 5-40 ps; Nernst-Einstein sigma = n q^2 D / (kB T), Haven ratio = 1

fit_full_5pt_400_1000.note: preferred for low-T extrapolation: anchored by the 400/500 K points

fit_highT_600_1000.note: original high-T-only fit (matches prior db value 27.82)

curvature.verdict: no clean super-Arrhenius curvature; segments zig-zag (low-T 400 K D has the largest statistical uncertainty). Full-5pt Ea 0.214 ~ high-T 0.207 => approximately Arrhenius 400-1000 K, so 300/273 K extrapolation is reasonably trustworthy.

caveat: MLIP classical Nernst-Einstein (Haven=1) overestimates ABSOLUTE sigma; Ea and the relative b2o3-vs-modelc comparison (same method/window) are the robust quantities. Absolute sigma is an upper-ish bound.
